# Random draws

Each call draws from the stream of the block (or agent) that evaluates it.

Each value is the expression evaluated on its own; a random call draws from a stream seeded 0.

## DISC

`DISC(value1, prob1, value2, prob2, ...)`: 2 or more arguments.

value/prob pairs (>= 1 pair), probs must sum to 1.

Example: `DISC(1, 0.5, 2, 0.3, 3, 0.2)` gives 3.

Used in the bundled models Container terminal: electrification, Container terminal: quay to yard, Priority jobs with rework, Walk-in clinic (library assets).

## EXPO

`EXPO(mean)`: 1 argument.

exponential(mean), sampled from the calling block's own rng.

Example: `EXPO(2)` gives 1.36.

Used in the bundled models Machine agent with repair, Server busy/idle cycle (agents), SIR epidemic (agents), Biogas plant (library assets) and 8 more.

## NORM

`NORM(mean, sd)`: 2 arguments.

normal(mean, sd), sampled from the calling block's own rng.

Example: `NORM(10, 2)` gives 9.736.

Used in the bundled models Boids flock (continuous, heading).

## RAND

`RAND()`: no arguments.

uniform [0, 1), sampled from the calling block's own rng.

Example: `RAND()` gives 0.8133.

Used in the bundled models Container terminal: electrification, Container terminal: quay to yard, Make-to-order line (library assets), Priority jobs with rework and 1 more.

## TRIA

`TRIA(low, mode, high)`: 3 arguments.

triangular(low, mode, high), sampled from the calling block's own rng.

Example: `TRIA(1, 2, 6)` gives 1.453.

Used in the bundled models Biogas plant (library assets), Container terminal: electrification, Container terminal: quay to yard, Order-driven warehouse (library assets) and 6 more.

## UNIF

`UNIF(low, high)`: 2 arguments.

uniform(low, high), sampled from the calling block's own rng.

Example: `UNIF(0, 10)` gives 0.1653.

Used in the bundled models Boids flock (continuous, heading), Nagel-Schreckenberg traffic (ring), Sugarscape with regrowth (grid, patches), Wolf-Sheep predation with grass (grid) and 2 more.
